title: Authority policy
description: Maps every coordinator action to an authority level. 1 autonomous: do it. 2 notify: do it, then report. 3 approve-if-reachable: ask first; if no answer by the deadline, apply the fallback. 4 hold for Earth: never done without an explicit approve. Earth can replace the policy at any time with a policy_update message.

ActionName.description: snake_case action name. Robot-level actions match command types (move_to, dig, cannibalize, ...); coordinator-level actions include replan, reassign_task, abandon_section, commit_energy_reserve.

policy_version.description: Incremented by Earth on every update.

default_level.description: Level for any action not listed in `levels`.

level3.description: Parameters for the approve-if-reachable fallback rule.

max_wait_s.description: Longest the coordinator may wait for an answer before applying the fallback.
